title: The Ox Hoof
part: The four books with no filmed scene (3, 7, 15, 20): Book 20's key scene, filmed for the first time
hypothesis: The scene is one action (a thrown ox hoof, a head turned aside, the wall struck) between two speeches. It reads if the hoof is seen in the hand during the mockery, in the air on its way past the beggar's head (the Stool's take 3: THROW with a prop flight and smear bricks), and the beggar's duck is seen in the same shot as the hoof going by; and if the scene's voice says the turns' lines, not the stale recording's fragments, and ends without the leaked last narration.
